result.description:
Our valued client, NEWCO FARMS is seeking a dedicated and experienced Animal Husbandry Technician to join their dynamic team. The ideal candidate will provide daily care, including feeding and cleaning, and monitoring the health and behavior of animals in the farm. Key responsibilities involve administering medications, assisting with procedures, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring the animals' living environments are clean and safe, all while adhering to strict specific protocols of Newco Farms.

Work location: Tamworth NSW

Duties include but will not be limited to:
Monitors and maintains the health and welfare of livestock
Assists with breeding and raising livestock
Monitors livestock to evaluate the effectiveness of feed formulae, and assists with the management of livestock nutrition and feeding programs
Provide food, water, and a clean-living environment for animals, which includes cleaning cages and enclosures
Observe animals for any signs of illness or distress, monitor their behavior, and report concerns to veterinary or research staff
Assists in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains
Administer prescribed medications and treatments, and assist veterinarians with medical procedures in strict compliance to Newco Farm’s guidelines including completion of all relevant reports and documentation. Such paperwork to be completed within the required timeframes
Artificially inseminates livestock for breeding purposes, conducts pregnancy tests, manages lactation, and cares for young animals
Collects and collates data for research purposes
Maintain detailed and accurate records of animal care, health, treatments, and procedures performed
Ensure animal housing areas and equipment are clean, sterile, and in good working order
Undertake or reorganise any work procedure as directed by the General Manager and Veterinary Services Manager or as deemed necessary in the absence of a member of staff
Safely handle and restrain animals for procedures, transportation, or other tasks
Ensure strict compliance with the principles of quarantine and biosecurity by all Newco Farm's farming operations
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures
Assist in the development and maintenance of Safe Work Practises. Support and implement the Company's Accident Prevention Program - support employees/work groups to ensure area is incident/accident free

Skills and knowledge
Proficiency in techniques for safely handling and restraining animals is essential
Ability to interpret animal behavior and a strong understanding of animal welfare principles are crucial
Knowledge of animal health, common diseases, and proper sanitation and hygiene practices is necessary
Organisational skills and familiarity with relevant software for record-keeping are important for maintaining accurate data
Strong communication skills are vital for working effectively with colleagues and supervisors
Technical skills on administering medication, performing basic lab techniques, or using specific farm equipment
Familiarity with regulations governing animal care is required

If you are ready to contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment, and feels this job could be the perfect opportunity for you, please apply now.
Salary: $100,000 per annum

Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.

  Configuration & Data Management: Deep functional knowledge of CM and Data Management principles and their associated tools.  
  IT & Engineering Acumen: Proficiency in IT combined with a solid understanding of project and engineering management lifecycles.

  Qualifications & Experience  
 
  Security Clearance: Must hold an active NV1 Australian Defence security clearance or have the ability to obtain one.

•	Permanent Role 
•	$85k-$90k PA 
•	Pinkenba QLD

POSITION

Full-time position for a Pressure Welder is available in Pinkenba, QLD, 4008.

SKILLS

At least an AQF Certificate III, including at least two years of on-the-job training or a Certificate Ivin a relevant field. At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification. In addition to the qualification at least one year of relevant work experience is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Pressure Welder is responsible for assembling, welding, inspecting, testing and repairing pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers, tanks and associated pressure-containing components in accordance with engineering drawings, approved welding procedures, relevant Australian Standards and industry specifications.
The role requires precision welding using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW processes on carbon steel, stainless steel and alloy materials in workshop and site environments.

POSITION DUTIES

•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, welding procedure specifications and technical specifications to determine job requirements and appropriate welding techniques for pressure systems.
•	Select, measure, cut, shape, bend, bevel, clean and prepare metal sections and pipes using hand tools, heating equipment and metalworking machinery.
•	Align, fit and secure pipes, vessel components and other pressure-containing components before welding.
•	Assemble, weld and repair pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers and tanks to relevant standards and approved welding procedures.
•	Operate welding equipment using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW
processes.
•	Weld in various positions, including vertical and overhead positions, and in confined spaces where required.
•	Conduct pre-heating, post-weld heat treatment, stress-relief and finishing processes as specified.
•	Examine welds for bead width, penetration, precision, defects and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
•	Conduct or assist with pressure, leak and other weld-integrity testing to confirm that pressure-containing systems meet required standards.
•	Repair defective welds and complete rework in accordance with approved procedures.
•	Clean and smooth welds by grinding, filing, chiselling and polishing as required.
•	Perform routine inspection and maintenance of welding equipment and report equipment defects. 
•	Comply with workplace health and safety requirements, permit systems and safe work procedures.
•	Work collaboratively with fabricators, boilermakers, inspectors and engineers to complete work to specification.

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES

•	Willingness to learn and develop new skills
•	Strong communication skills
•	High level of attention to detail
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety
•	Effective problem-solving skills
•	Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

SALARY

$85,000 - $90,000 per annum based on experience.

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/
